title: Content Copy
content: # **Objective** You can copy a Content to a different Workroom, or within the same Workroom. When Contents are copied, it will bring with it all of the details within. 1. Content Copy 2. Copy Type 3. Copy as Linked Content # # **Details** ### 1) Content Copy * Enter the Workroom in which the desired Content is located. * Select the Content * Select 'Copy' from the floating menu![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778918990489) * Enter the name of the Copy * Select Copy Type, and select the Workroom to generate the Copy in * To make it a Linked Content, turn on the option ### 2)Copy Type ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778919242905) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/50931188948889) ---|--- 1. Only Content : Only the selected content file will be copied 2. Copy with Comments/Annotations : The content file along with its comments and annotations will be copied. 3. Copy with Web Tech Pack : The web tech pack data will be copied together. (Comments in the WTP will be copied, but the basic comments and annotations will not be copied.) ### ### 3)Copy as Linked Content ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778919242905) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/50944982965529) ---|--- 1. Turn on 'Make a Child Content' option 2. Enter a Memo about the Child Content, and click 'OK' 3. Your will see a Child Content has been created at the selected Workroom 4. From the Parent Content, click on the 'Linked Content' button to view the full list. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778947550873) *When you create a copy within the same Company space as the original file, **Workflow & Category** information will be copied as well. If not, it will be reset. *When you multi-copy and create Child Content, each copy will be linked to the same garment only. For example, if you select garment A,B,C and copy them with Child Content option, _garment A_ will be linked to the _copy of garment A_ only.
content_description: This webpage provides a step-by-step guide for copying content between workrooms, detailing options for including comments, annotations, and creating linked content.

title: Console - Data Intelligence
content: #### Permission: ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778936912793) Group Admin, Group Operator # **Objective** ![Shape \(2\).png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778937118489) | Access Admin Console by clicking ![mceclip0.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778959663897) icon on your CLO-SET dashboard. Admin Console shows the Group summary, Billing, Data Intelligence, Activity Log, Settings, and Developer Page. ---|--- On the Data Intelligence tab, you may review details on your user activity and Content. 1. User Activity 2. Content * Total Color Composition Rate * Trends Chart * Scatter Chart 3. Leadtime 4. Cost Saving # **Details** ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/50123313987481) **Menu** | **Sub-Menu** | **Details** ---|---|--- Data Intelligence | * User Activity * Content * Leadtime * Cost Saving | View usage statistics per user, including content views and rendering usage. In addition, view Color analytics of your Contents. Leadtime and Cost Saving analysis shows the workflow efficiency and potential sample cost savings ### 1) User Activity ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778932244889) 1. Filter the time period to view 2. Filter the type of users to view * Active users are anyone with more at least 1 count of the measured values. * Inactive users are those who did not use any of the counted values. 3. Search specific users with their registered name or email to view their usage 4. Name and Email of the user. Users who have been deleted from the Group and no longer have permission will be greyed out. 5. Click on the field to sort - either in ascending or descending order ### 2) Content ![Screenshot 2023-07-28 at 5.01.22 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778951263897) * Filter the Date & Workroom you want to view * For Group Operators, the 'Space' filter will only display the list of Spaces to which they have Viewer or above permission to. Group Admin can select any Space within the Group. * Total Style Contents: Total number of Contents uploaded during the date range, and included in the statistics shown below. This covers ONLY the Contents you have viewing permission to. * Average Used Colors: Average number of Colors used per Style Content * Total Fabric Colors: Total number of Fabric Color used within the selected Space *ONLY Applicable to any Content uploaded on March, 2023 and onward. #### **1\. Total Color Composition Rate** ![Total_Color_Composition_Rate.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778951412633) The Doughnut Chart on the left shows the distribution of Primary Colors used for the Style Contents. Hover over the Color to view the details. On the right hand table, click on each Primary Color to view all the related Original Colors. * Primary Color: Main Color(Hex/Pantone) with the highest usage rate among similar color group * Original Color: All unique Colors used. Grouped by Primary Color. *Color usage rate is calculated based on the fabric size #### **2\. Trends Chart**![Period](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778983106073) Trends Chart shows the number of Style Content that used the top 10 Primary Colors over time. You may view the Color Trend chronically. Change the chart type to _Bar or Line_ , or change period to _Week or Year_ to change the view. Bar Chart ![BarChart.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778938710041) | Line Chart ![ColorTrend.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778938989849) ---|--- #### #### **3\. Scatter Chart** ![Color](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778939302809) Scatter Chart visualizes the Saturation/Brightness of the Colors used. Click on the Primary Color to view the Original Colors included in the group. * **X-axis** : Hue (Color Spectrum of 0~360) * **Y-axis** : Saturation or Brightness per your selection. Click on the upper left dropdown button to switch the view. * **Marker Size:** Number of Style Contents that used the selected Color. ### 3) Leadtime ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/50834306994073)Leadtime Analysis shows the workflow efficiency with a clear **summary of lead times** , **completion trends** , and the **current status of all contents** in their Workroom. 1. Summary : Displays the total content and overall lead time at the top. * Total Style Content : The total amount of style content in the space (or selected space) 2. Average Leadtime : Displays the average time it takes for content to move through each workflow step, based on the applied filters. 3. Average Spent time : Displays the average time spent at each workflow step for the filtered contents in a Space. 4. Style List : Lists the current lead times for all Style contents in the Workroom. 5. Export : Lead time analysis data on the screen can be exported to PDF. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/50123313998745) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/50123314002201) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/50123314005657) ---|--- Visit Leadtime menu of Data Intelligence, select the 'space' and 'category' to see the analysis. * The Space option is only visible when a user with admin permission accesses the Admin Console. * The analysis data is updated and displayed based on the previous day. > **_Items uploaded after April 2025 with no workflow status changes may be excluded from the list._** ### 4) Cost Saving ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/50123610837785) Cost Saving Analysis shows the**potential sample cost savings** across all Style contents in Workrooms. The savings are calculated based on the **number of versions** and **colorways per style** , multiplied by a **sampling cost** defined by the user. 1. Summary : Displays the total styles, colorways, default sample cost and total saving cost at the top. * Total Style : Total number of contents with ‘Style’ content type. * Total Colorway : Total number of digital sample versions created across styles. * Default Sample Cost : Default sampling cost to estimate the total saving cost. * Total Saving Cost : Sum of estimated savings across all styles, calculated by: Total Colorways × Sampling Cost (per style) 2. Colorways per workflow : Displays the total number of colorways at each workflow status. 3. Sample Saving Cost per Content : Displays Each style’s saving is calculated as: colrway x Sampling Cost (per style) 4. Export : Cost saving analysis data on the screen can be exported to PDF. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/50123314013849) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/50123314002201) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/50123314005657) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/50123314015769) ---|---|--- Visit Cost Saving Analysis menu of Data Intelligence, select the 'space' , 'category' and 'workflow' to see the cost analysis. * The Space option is only visible when a user with admin permission accesses the Admin Console. * The analysis data is updated and displayed based on the previous day. > **_Items uploaded after April 2025 with no workflow status changes may be excluded from the list._**
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide for Group Admins and Operators to navigate the Admin Console, access data intelligence features, and analyze user activity, content statistics, lead times, and cost-saving opportunities.

title: Change Plan / Unsubscribe
content: # **Objective** Learn how to cancel your Advanced Plan subscription and downgrade to free plan. 1. Change Plan * Upgrade * Downgrade (Unsubscribe) 2. Refund Policy *Before you start: Plan type can only be managed by[ Group Admin or Group Operator](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303153376537). Changing your plan type will affect everyone in your [Group](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185480985). # **Details** ### 1) Change Plan * To change your plan type, visit [Console - Summary](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303236765721). * Make sure you are in the correct Group. Check the Group name on the top-left corner of your screen. To switch Groups, click on the downward arrow (⌄) next to the Group name. * Click 'Change Plan' on the right to select a new plan. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778328362905) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778328565657) ---|--- ### ⬆️ Upgrade Upgrading will take place **immediately** after the payment is made. 1\. Upgrading from **Standard to Premium** * * Your remaining measurement period for the Standard plan will be refunded in credit form, to be applied automatically for your new Premium plan subscription. * Example) Billing changes when upgrading from Standard to Premium ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778314053401) 1\. Once the upgrading is initiated, your Standard plan subscription will be cancelled. If you had any remaining days under the Standard plan, the unused days will be refunded in the form of credit. * * * In this example, $92.80 has been refunded (for the unused 28 days, for 5 users). This resulted in a total credit balance of $54.24 based on previous bill history (which means that the previous credit balance was -$38.56) 2\. Premium plan subscription created immediately. * * * A new bill is created for 5 users with a charge of $200 ($40 x 5). This resulted in a total credit balance of -$145.76 ($54.24 - $200.00). Negative credit indicates that the user owes the amount to be paid. 3\. Payment completed, and Premium plan subscription started. 2\. Upgrading from **Free to paid plans** (Standard or Premium) * From [Console - Summary](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303236765721), click on 'Subscribe' ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778329034265) * From the [CLO-SET Pricing](https://style.clo-set.com/service/pricing) page, select a plan to subscribe, and follow the [payment process.](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171146009) ### ⬇️ Downgrade (Unsubscribe) Downgrading will take place on your Group's **next renewal date**. Please note that CLO-SET does not refund the unused days of your monthly subscription once it is initiated. 1\. Downgrading from **Premium to Standard** * Important: Once your Group is downgraded to the Standard plan, there will be restrictions on the Group's usage. Please make sure to review the restrictions to minimize disruption. * Your existing Premium plan subscription will be valid until the end of your measurement period. On your next renewal date, your plan will be changed to Standard. * You **CANNOT** downgrade if your current usage exceeds the plan limit of the Standard plan. Please review your usage on '[Console - Billing - Usage History](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303239183257)' and make changes accordingly. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778329183129) | ![Pricing Page Modal.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778329308313) ---|--- 2\. Downgrading from **Premium/Standard to Free** * Downgrading will take place on your Group's next renewal date. Please note that CLO-SET does not refund the unused days of your monthly subscription once it is initiated. * If you had pending**negative credit balance** (to be paid) at the point of downgrading, you will be charged for the amount before your subscription is cancelled. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778329438361) * If you had pending**positive credit balance** at the point of downgrading, or failure of repurchasing, your credit will be 0 upon downgrading to free, and a billing history entry will be created. * For accounts that have already downgraded to Free before August 12, 2025, any existing positive credit will not be removed and remain) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778302557849) * You **CANNOT** downgrade if your current usage exceeds the plan limit of the Free plan. Please review your usage on '[Console - Billing - Usage History](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303239183257)' and make changes accordingly. ### 2) Refund Policy * Your subscription is valid until the end of Measurement Period, unless there was an upgrade attempt. * Please note that under [CLO-SET TOS](https://style.clo-set.com/policy/terms-of-service), no refunds are made for unused number of days in cash form, unless required by law. * For any inquiries, please [contact us](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/requests/new).
content_description: This webpage provides step-by-step instructions to cancel your Advanced Plan subscription and downgrade to a free plan, along with important details on billing and refund policies.

Find more details on [Billing Guideline](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303191886361) 4. **Charges** : Amount billed or paid per the event on description * Positive values (+): indicate paid amount OR credit that can be used for your next payment * Negative values (-): charged to the user to be paid in future 5. **Credit balance** : Remaining credit balance as a result of each event. * Positive values (+): credit that can be used for your next payment * Negative values (-): amount owed to be paid in future * from below image, 1️⃣ ➕ 2️⃣ 🟰 3️⃣ ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778941893529) * ### Invoice * Click on the Invoice no. to print or download your invoice. Please note that the 'To' field will display the user id and email of the account that first initiated the payment (either Group Admin or Group Operator account will be listed). * On the invoice, you can find the list of members that has been charged for the listed subscription period. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778942101913) ### 2) User History #### 1\. Permission Approval * Find the list of permission requests & full list of users approved/pending/rejected from the Group **[All User Status]** Displays the full list of users invited to the Group (including approved, pending, removed) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778925421465) * * **Status** of the accounts are displayed as one of the four below: * Pending: pending request for approval to * Rejected: permission request rejected * Approved: request approved but the user is not registered on CLO-SET * Reapproved: request that had previously been rejected, then approved afterwards * Clicking on the active user's account email to view [Permission Management](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303209418649) info for the selected account **[Pending Users]** Displays the list of requests that are pending/rejected ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778880587033) * Once the new member is approved, the user will be deleted from the 'pending users' tab (but continue to display on the 'all user status' tab) * If the same user has been invited multiple times, approving the user on any 1 of the rows will automatically approve all requests #### 2\. User Type Change * View the full list of changes on Group members that affects your subscription amount. * **For more information on permission by space, visit 'Permission Management' tab within Admin Console.** ![userhis.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778925775897) #### 3\. Email Change * View the list of users within the Group with the email change history. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778942837401) ### 3) Usage History ![Screenshot 2024-11-01 at 6.20.30 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778897328921) * View the Group's feature usage history per measurement period. * User/Company/Workroom is displayed as max count by period * File Upload/Rendering/Embed View/API Call is displayed as total count by period * For more details on how CLO-SET measures each field, visit [Feature Usage Measurement Criteria](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303208104857) * Depending on your group's subscribed plan, there may be restrictions on field usage. Enter the URL and click 'Update' button. 2\. Go to style page. You can see the sync button activated. ![style_sync](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/common/images/style_sync.png) 3\. Click sync button to open new tab with the URL you entered above. The new tab's URL contains Style ID, style version, external style ID as query string. ### [Set Render trigger] 1\. Click 'ADD TRIGGER' under Render section. 2\. Choose workflow status that fires the trigger. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778990334233) 3\. Go to Workroom or Style page and change Workflow of style, and refresh your browser to initiate Render. _*Render will be requested with the uploaded file's render properties set in CLO S/W._ ![RenderTrigger.gif](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778990683545) #### Potential Error Cases in Render Trigger Fail * In any case where render cannot be completed, Render Trigger can not also be completed * When file has not completed parsing * When file has failed parsing * When Render Setting is not yet set * Render Setting has to be set in order for Render Trigger to properly work #### Render Properties of CLO3D * Rendering properties can be saved as .zvrp. It can also be opened in CLO3D. ![](https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/IJpthF2Vv7VzUy4yc_9eFfkmHoKt9mGB83E0llEuZq18sTsl6Sws7QhHweS9l3Ux89xpIoGrgnKp_SN-NFh3uzgU8YiZblRU3hBJrffftCsaSb0zIdCJCMUwDEwbU4t-l9SfRMJr4xFkjpxwq4FWzyA) | ![](https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/L6yX0jT-bYhSn4XLtsB2jjmCHdIWMDMEF6EfqmzuD_3_9Q7DKTu_IWQdWfboncOiLVDUZ-6fTA6b5CcY5rILFTCGMpk2GjA9NTmPebmGuDc5xupldr__A_GA-DRYgXnk5lJ7uievTfgS_EXELt5Fxv0) ---|--- Render Properties of CLO3D When your Rendering Properties are established, you can then load the saved Rendering Properties without having to configure Rendering Properties every time. The loaded Rendering Properties will be saved as part of the .zprj file to be used in CLO-SET Trigger. ### [Set Webhook] #### 1\. Click 'Add trigger' under webhook section. 2\. Choose the trigger use case at which you want to fire the trigger. CLO-SET currently offers webhooks for 5 different use cases. \- Workflow: You can set a webhook to be fired at a specific Content Workflow. \- Invite / Share: You can set a webhook to be fired when a user has been invited/shared to a Space/Content. \- Content Upload: You can set a webhook to be fired when a Content is uploaded. \- Version Upload: You can set a webhook to be fired when a Version is uploaded. \- Colorway Status: You can set a webhook to be fired at a specific Colorway Status. 3\. Enter the URL that webhook will be requested. 4\. Enter the Name and Value if you want to check whether the request is valid. It will be added in HTTP header with webhook request. Webhook request body sample { "UpdateTime": "2020-07-21T06:25:09.759785Z", "UpdateUser": "hello@clo-set.com", "Topic": { "TopicId": "4ea0710a0e5f4e099d92f7a284d167f9", "Version": 1, "TopicType": 1 }, "TriggerType": 1, "TriggerOption": { "WorkflowSeq": 1679, "TriggerStatus": 1 } } Webhook body schema { "UpdateTime": { "$id": "#/properties/UpdateTime", "type": "string", "format": "date-time", "description": "The update time that trigger fired." }, "UpdateUser": { "$id": "#/properties/UpdateUser", "type": "string", "description": "Email address of user" }, "Topic": { "$id": "#/properties/Topic", "type": "object", "description": "The updated space/style information", "required": [ "TopicId", "Version", "TopicType" ], "properties": { "TopicId": { "$id": "#/properties/Topic/properties/TopicId", "type": "string", "description": "The id of updated style or space" }, "Version": { "$id": "#/properties/Topic/properties/Version", "type": "integer", "description": "Version of style. Will be '0' if topic type is not style.", "default": 0 }, "TopicType": { "$id": "#/properties/Topic/properties/TopicType", "type": "integer", "enum": [0, 1], "description": "Enum for what the topic type is. 0 is none, 1 is style.", "default": "None" } } }, "TriggerType": { "$id": "#/properties/TriggerType", "type": "integer", "enum": [0, 1], "description": "The trigger type that webhook triggered. 0 is none, 1 is workflow", "default": 0 }, "TriggerOption": { "$id": "#/properties/TriggerOption", "type": "object", "description": "The object information for trigger", "required": [ "WorkflowSeq", "TriggerStatus" ], "properties": { "WorkflowSeq": { "$id": "#/properties/TriggerOption/properties/WorkflowSeq", "type": "integer", "description": "Workflow seq that tiggered." }, "TriggerStatus": { "$id": "#/properties/TriggerOption/properties/TriggerStatus", "type": "integer", "enum": [0, 1], "description": "The changed trigger status for triggered object. 0 is none, 1 is changed", "default": 0 } } } }

title: Billing Guideline
content: # **Objective** Understand how CLO-SET Group Pricing works, as well as invoices and billing. 1. Payment per Group 2. Automatic Renewal 3. Who is included in the bill? 4. Adding/Removing Users 5. What is Credit? 6. Refund 7. Example: Your Billing History Explained # **Details** ### 1\. Payment per Group * CLO-SET Pricing plan operates on a [**Group**](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185480985) level. Subscribing to the Standard or Premium plan will be applied to all members within your Group. ### 2\. Automatic Renewal * Your subscription will be renewed every month. The monthly payment amount for your subscription may vary based on the number of users within your Group. * *All renewals are made on the same day your subscription started. As an exception, if you subscribed on the 31st, renewal will be done on the last day of every month (ex. on the months with 30 days only, your renewal will be on the 30th). ### 3\. Who is included in the bill? All users invited to or shared within the Group are included in the billing. This encompasses users with the following permissions: * Group Admin * Company Admin * Company Collaborator * Brand Admin * Brand Collaborator * Editor * Viewer **Note:** Users with only Group Operator permission are excluded from billing. Find out more on Permissions [HERE](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303153376537). To view or manage your Group's permissions, please visit [Permission Management](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303195393049) tab. ### 4\. Adding/Removing users during your subscription You may need to add additional team members to your Group after your subscription has begun. * **Adding User:** Charged on the next billing cycle. Amount calculated on a daily basis. Each additional user will be charged for the # of days they were in the Group (ex. for Premium Plan: $40➗ # of days in month). * The amount will be recorded as Credit on your Group. Please see below for an example. * **Removing User** : If you delete a user during your billing cycle, the amount of unused days will be refunded in a form of Credit on your account (ex. for Premium Plan: $40 ➗ # of days in month). This additional Credit will automatically be used on your next payment. However, these addition credit cannot be transferred into cash refunds. Please see below for an example. * _Added users are billed from the day they have been added. Removed users are refunded including the day they have been removed._ _* All 'days' are counted based on the UTC timezone._ _* **Note:** The Active/Inactive status does not affect billing. It simply indicates whether a user is currently using the features. Even users marked as Inactive on the **User Activity** page are still considered paid users._ ### 5\. What is Credit? * Any changes on number of users within your Group will be reflected on your Group's Credit. All Credit Balance will be processed in your next payment. See below for examples. ### 6\. Refund * CLO-SET does not provide refunds for the subscription once it is initiated. Addition credits will be forfeited without cash refunds when downgrading to the Free plan. * Your credit balance will be retained when switching between Premium and Standard plans. ### 7\. Example: Your Billing History Explained ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777989667737) 1. **Subscription Created** : Billed for 5 users on the Premium Plan. 2. **Payment Complete** : Payment complete, subscription started for 5 users. 3. **Added 1 User to the Group:** The additional user will be billed as a prorated credit based on the number of days remaining until the renewal date. The accrued credit will be charged on the Group's next renewal date. * In this example, total credit billed is $33.10 * (Price per user / Total days in billing period) * Remaining days until renewal * ($40 / 29) * 24 = $33.10 * This amount is billed on your next renewal date. 4. **Removed 1 User from the Group:** The unused days for this member will be refunded as a credit and automatically applied to your next payment. * In this example, total credit refunded is $33.33 * (Price per user / Total days in billing period) * Remaining days until renewal * ($40 / 30) * 25 = $33.33 * This amount will automatically apply to your next payment. However, canceling your subscription (switching to the Free Plan) will forfeit this credit.
content_description: This webpage aims to clarify the CLO-SET Group Pricing structure, including payment details, invoicing, user management, and credit policies.

title: Search
content: # **Objective** Find your Contents with the search feature in CLO-SET. Find it fast. Find it easy. 1. [Search Tab](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/undefined#h_01H570RFSHKRKYPQ938B1SVKTB) 2. Keyword Search 3. Image Search 4. Filters 5. View / Sort Option 6. Workroom/Assortment Search # **Details** ### 1) Search Tab * Access the Search tab from the dashboard. Click the 'Search' icon on the far left. ![Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 9.10.54 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776088187161) | ![Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 9.17.22 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776097100057) ---|--- 1. 1. Keyword search 2. Image search 3. Reset search options 4. Filter search results 5. View/Sort option ### 2) Text Search ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776112246297) Search using the Content Name, Creator, or Content ID. Please note that only the Contents to which you have access to will be displayed as the search result. ### 3) Image Search ![Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 9.56.08 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776114269721) | ![Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 9.56.38 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776128898969) ---|--- To start searching with image files, click on 'search by image' icon next to the magnifier icon. Upload an image file, and click 'Apply'. CLO-SET AI will detect the shape, color, and pattern and find similar Contents. * Start searching with image files such as: * Rendered output of your Content * Physical image of the design * Pattern images used for the Content ![CLO-SET_Default_Final_Butter.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776114562073) | ► | ![Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 10.05.37 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776145656985) ---|---|--- ### 4) Filters ![Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 10.16.15 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776098255769) Use Search filters to expand or narrow down the search results. Learn what each of the filters indicate: * [Content Type](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801): Each Content is classified as a single Content Type. You may select the Content Type at the time of upload, or CLO-SET will auto-assign one based on your file format. * [Space](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303240419865): Select a Company, Brand, or Workroom Space to conduct the search. Click on the ► icon view lower-level Spaces. Once the selection is made, click 'Next'. * User must have 'Viewer' or above permission to select the respective Space. * [Workflow](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303233641241) / [Category](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303202913049): Can only be applied once the Space selection is made. ### 5) View/Sort Option ![Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 10.27.10 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776115130649) --- Modify viewing and sorting options: * View By: * Contents: Search results will show each Content only * Colorway: Search results will show each Colorway of the Content * Sort By: * Last Modified * Name: Sorting based on the file name. * [Workflow](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303233641241): Sorting based on the Workflow steps identified from your Company Settings * Relevance : Sorts results based on how closely they match the search keyword or image ### 6) Workroom/Assortment Search Users can search for a specific Workroom or Assortment by its name. Select the 'Workroom' or 'Assortment' option from the 'Search For' drop down next to the search bar. #### **1\. In Company, Brand, Line, Season** * From the 'Search For' drop-down menu, select 'Workroom' or 'Assortment' ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776146241433) * Type in the keyword to search for Workroom/Assortment. Search results display Workroom/Assortment with names that includes your input (Do not support placeholders) * When you search for a Workroom/Assortment within a specific Space (Company, Brand, or Line), ALL associated Workrooms/Assortments within that Space will be displayed * Hover over the Workroom to view the location path ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776098799129) #### **2\. In Season** * From the 'Search For' drop-down menu, select 'Workroom' or 'Assortment' ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776146620441) * Type in the keyword to search for Workroom/Assortment. Search results display Workroom/Assortment with names that includes your input (Do not support placeholders) * When you search for a Workroom/Assortment within the selected Season * Please note that the search results will **only** display either Workrooms or Assortments per your selection. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776157509913) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776116190233) ---|--- #### **3\. In Workroom** * From the 'Search For' drop-down menu, select 'Workroom' * Contents of Current Room: search the Contents within the current level Workroom only * Contents Including Child Rooms: search the contents from the current Workroom and all its child Workrooms. * Workrooms: search the Child Workrooms within the current Workroom * Type in the keyword to search for Child Workrooms. Search results display all Child Workrooms with names that includes your input (Do not support placeholders) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776116413465)
content_description: Easily find your contents in CLO-SET with our streamlined search features, including keyword and image search, filters, and sorting options.

title: Create Visual Board
content: # **📝 List of Contents** 📍CLO-SET [Visual Board](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303200610841) provides a blank canvas to make presentations with your 3D assets. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777927326233) 1. Enter Visual Board 2. Create & Edit 3. Upload Content(s) 4. Invite Editors 5. Share SlideShow # **📓 Details** **1\. Enter Visual Board** --- * Log in to CLO-SET and Click 'Visual Board' at the bottom of the 'Workspace' menu. * A new Visual Board page will open. Click on the '+' button to create a new Board. * If you are invited to an existing Board, please check the Group Name at the top. You can enter different Groups by clicking on the downward arrow (⌄) next to the Group name at the top left. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777952087193) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777912695577) **2\. Create & Edit **[(view full tutorial)](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303200610841) --- * Before getting into the action, we recommend creating a test Board to explore the feature. * Type in the title and explanation, and click 'Create'. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777952396953) * Add text, shapes, and drag & drop the Contents to the Board. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777913164697) * When inserting a 3D Content, you will be able to select the viewpoint & link to 3D Viewer. * * **Add Images** : select a viewpoint to add the image * **Link** : insert a link to the 3D Viewer for the end users to access the 3D Viewer. * When complete, you will see a purple URL icon indicating the attached URL. ![Screenshot 2024-04-04 at 3.44.47 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777952783385) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777913657881) * Find the full list of edit tools and instructions **[HERE](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303200610841)** * Once you are done editing the Board, click the 'Save' button at the top. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777943443865) **3\. Upload Content(s)** --- * To attach your 3D design on the Visual Board, you must first upload the file * [Learn how to upload here](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303166737305) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777928921753) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777953659545) * Once uploading is complete, use the Space selection modal on the right pane of the Visual Board to locate the uploaded file. | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777914330521) | **=** | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777928921753) ---|---|---|--- **4\. Invite Editors** --- * Share the Board to invite others to edit the Board * Click the 'Share' button ![share.svg](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777929306393) at the top-right corner to add Board Editors * Type in the email address, and hit enter. Click 'Share' * The recipient will receive an email notification ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777954512537) * Note: Unless shared from other Space/Contents, **recipient's access will be limited to the Visual Board only**. Learn how to share [Contents](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303176205081) or [Space](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303184310681) **5\. Share SlideShow** --- * Share Slideshow to others to view the Visual Board SlideShow * Click 'Slide Show' to start. On the Slide Show, click the share button ![share.svg](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777929306393) at the top-right corner * Select access option: * **Restricted** : Only those invited as Editors (on step #4) can view the Slide Show * **Publish** : Anyone with link can view the Slide Show (CLO-SET Account required to view) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777954786073) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777915212441)
content_description: Create stunning presentations using CLO-SET's Visual Board, where you can easily upload 3D assets, collaborate with editors, and share your slideshow with others.

title: Plan Restrictions (Measurement Standard)
content: # **Objective** Understand plan limits and how the usage fields are calculated in CLO-SET. Your Group may have limited availability on selective features. Check[ CLO-SET Pricing Page](https://style.clo-set.com/service/pricing) for more details. 1. User 2. Company & Workroom 3. File Upload 4. Rendering 5. Embed View 6. CLO-SET API 7. Usage History 8. Plan Limit Error & Upgrade # **Details** Based on your Group's usage, you may need to upgrade your plan or pay additional charges. Visit **[CLO-SET Pricing page](https://style.clo-set.com/service/pricing)** to find the full list of plan types and feature availability. ![Screenshot 2025-05-28 at 5.31.58 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47456838666137) ### ### 1) User * Free Plan: invite/share with up to 3 users * Standard/Premium Plan: invite/share unlimited number of users. Charges apply per the number of users in the Group. * Users with Admin, Collaborator, Editor, or Viewer permission to any Space within the Group will be counted towards billing. Group Operators are not included. * Review the full list of users in the Group on [Console - Settings - Permission Management](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303209418649). * If CLO employees are invited to your Group for support, they are excluded from the user count. ### 2) Company & Workroom * Free Plan: create up to 1 Company and 1 Workroom * Standard Plan: create up to 1 Company and 10 Workrooms * Premium Plan: unlimited Space creation * All Companies and [Workrooms](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303190956697) within the Group are counted, even if there is no Content uploaded within the Space. * On CLO-SET dashboard, click 'Workspace' button from the left pane. Click 'All Companies' or 'All Workrooms' to view the full list, and make changes if needed. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778415314329) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778431143577) ### 3) File Upload * Free Plan: up to 10 files uploads per month. Renewed on the 1st of each month. * Standard/Premium Plan: unlimited file uploads and storage. * All file uploads, including version uploads and deleted files, are counted. * 'Sample.zprj' file created as a default is excluded from the count. * Visit [Console - Billing - Usage History](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303239183257) to review the file upload usage for each measurement period. ### 4) [Rendering](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303207203225) * Rendering usage is based on the Render output file size. For Rendering details, visit 'Workspace - Rendering' or '[Console - Billing - Usage History](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303239183257)' * Free Plan * up to 50MB per month. Limit resets on the 1st of each month. You must upgrade your plan to use more Rendering. * Premium & Standard Plan * up to 3 GB (Premium) or 1 GB (Standard) per user in the Group each month. Limit resets on the subscription renewal date. * Additional charges apply for usage exceeding the limit. **$10 per 1 GB** will be billed on the group’s next payment. * When you add a user to the group during your subscription, we’ll adjust the usage based on the remaining days and provide a proportional amount. ### 5) [Embed Viewer](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303195817497) * The Embed Viewer count is based on the number of times end users open the Embed Viewer created from the content within your group. This includes all direct visits via the URL/QR code and access through the 3D Viewer URL embedded in your [Visual Board](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303200610841). * Visit '[Console - Billing - Usage History](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303239183257)' to view the current status. * Add-on purchase option is not available for Embed Viewer usage. Please**upgrade or add users** to the Group to allow more view counts. * Free Plan * up to 30 views per month. Limit resets on the 1st of each month. You must upgrade for additional usage. * Standard Plan * up to 100 views per user in the Group each month. Limit resets on the subscription renewal date. You must upgrade for additional usage. * Premium Plan * up to 300 views per user in the Group each month. ### 6) [CLO-SET API ](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303242212505) * CLO-SET API is available under the Premium plan or Enterprise plan only. * All API calls made for your Group will be counted, except the oAuth option. * Premium Plan * up to 300 API Calls per user in the Group each month. Limit resets on the subscription renewal date. * Additional charges apply for usage exceeding the limit. **$5 per 300 calls** will be billed on the group’s next payment. ### 7) Usage History To review your Group's feature usage, please visit [Console - Billing - Usage History](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303239183257). ### 8) Plan Limit Error & Upgrade * If your group exceeds the plan limit, you'll see an error message prompting an upgrade. * Group Admin & Group Operators * Visit [Console > Summary](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303236765721) and click 'Change Plan' to upgrade the plan * All other permission * You will not be able to upgrade the Group's plan. Please contact your Group Admin. ![Screenshot 2025-05-28 at 5.35.08 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47456812712729) ---
content_description: This web page aims to clarify plan limits and usage calculations in CLO-SET, guiding users on how to manage their group’s features and potentially upgrade their subscription for enhanced access.
